notes.text: Open-map sniper for Bounty/Wipeout-style modes: charged shots threaten one-shot kills from afar; ~70% charge is enough to hold lane.
Water-walking trait makes water-heavy maps (e.g. Canal Grande) a unique strength — evades short-range pursuers entirely.
Stinging Flight jump answers dive (escape tanks/assassins) and enables thrower hunts; Heist tech: jump onto the safe + Super for 8000.
